name: Chart
summary: The AhaSlides chart library — one framework-free <aha-chart> for Bar, Column, Stacked, Donut, Word cloud and Mind map results, in the brand palette on app screens or the deck palette on the presenting canvas.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-chart type="…"> — draws every result chart with the same look wherever it is used. Where it lives decides its colours: palette="brand" (default) for Report and any other app screen uses the --aha-viz-* brand chart palette; palette="deck" on the presenting / audience canvas takes the deck's presentationColorPalette (`colors`) and text colour (`ink`), and derives any ink that sits on a fill from that fill's contrast. The chart never paints a background and never carries state colours. Live data animates in place (marks grow, resize and re-rank on the --aha-motion-viz-* tokens; off under reduced motion), and every chart ships a text summary, a visually hidden data table and a polite live-region announcement when its data changes. Built-in copy ("Waiting for responses", "Other", screen-reader summaries) follows `locale`, numbers use Intl for that locale, and the Presenter app can pass its own translations through `strings`.
codeNote: Set `data` as a property for live results (re-setting it animates the change); the `data` attribute takes the same JSON for static pages. Result charts on app screens use this, not @ant-design/plots.

spec.label: Types
spec.value: bar · column · stacked · donut · wordcloud · mindmap (Radial, Radar, Tree map, Quadrant, Bell curve: next release)

spec.label: Palette
spec.value: brand = --aha-viz-series-1…6 (#714CF5 #E96144 #189D96 #A95166 #D49900 #4491C4) · deck = consumer colours + ink · transparent background · Other = --aha-viz-neutral #A8A29B

spec.label: Ink
spec.value: #313131; secondary 76% / tertiary 54% / track 7% / hover 8% mixes of the ink (re-derived from the deck ink on the canvas)

spec.label: Bar
spec.value: track 38 · gap 14 · radius 8 · value 20/600 + share 16 tertiary

spec.label: Column
spec.value: plot 260 · column ≤96 wide · gap 28 (8 under 480) · label clamps to 2 lines

spec.label: Donut
spec.value: ring 38% of the radius · callouts with leader lines; a legend when narrower than ~470px

spec.label: Empty
spec.value: 0 responses → grey placeholder marks + "Waiting for responses"

spec.label: Overflow
spec.value: past max-items the smallest options fold into "Other" (stacked: the trailing series) · percentages use largest-remainder rounding so they total 100% · long labels truncate, full text in the tooltip · a wide mind map goes one-sided, then scrolls inside itself

spec.label: Motion
spec.value: enter 600ms + 40ms stagger · update 400ms · re-rank 350ms · --aha-ease-viz · none under prefers-reduced-motion

spec.label: A11y
spec.value: host role=figure + aria-label · text summary · hidden data table (mind map: nested list) · polite <aha-live-region> on data updates

props.name: data
props.desc: bar/column/donut/wordcloud: [{label, value}] · stacked: {series: [..], rows: [{label, values: [..]}]} · mindmap: {label, children: [..]}

props.name: palette
props.desc: brand on app screens (Report…); deck on the presenting/audience canvas

props.name: sort
props.desc: Order; desc also shows rank numbers on a bar chart. Other always stays last

props.name: highlight-top
props.desc: Dim everything below the top N

props.name: log-scale
props.desc: Log lengths for bar/column when values span orders of magnitude

props.name: legend
props.desc: Auto: on for stacked, and for a donut too narrow for callouts

props.name: tooltip
props.desc: Hover tooltip with the full label and value

props.name: max-items
props.default: bar 10 · column 8 · donut 6 · stacked 6 series · wordcloud 60
props.desc: Cap before the rest fold into Other (word cloud drops the tail)

props.name: responses
props.desc: Respondent count for the summary and the donut centre

props.name: locale
props.desc: Built-in copy (en, vi) + Intl number format

props.name: strings
props.desc: Override any built-in string with the Presenter app's translation

whenToUse.when: results on the presenting or audience canvas of a slide type — Poll, Pick Answer, Ranking, Split the point, Word cloud, Brainstorm/Mind map
the same results anywhere else in the Presenter app — Report, dashboards, summaries
a single headline number, not a distribution
a chart type <aha-chart> does not ship yet (line/area/time series)

opinion.note: Never hand-roll result bars with divs or pull a chart engine into the slide canvas: the look, the empty/overflow states and the accessibility layer live here once. Charts never carry state colours — mark a correct answer with a ✓ icon next to the label, not a green bar. The --aha-viz-* values are lifted from the PRO38-69 mockup and are expected to be refined by a token owner; change the tokens, never the element.
opinion.dsv3: New in the DS (PRO38-69) — the visual source is the "AhaSlides Chart Slides" mockup; a signed-off exception to the @ant-design/plots rule for result charts.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI. The [data-probe] is the ranked brand-palette bar chart: first fill is --aha-viz-series-1, the track and value sizes are the mockup's, the host is a labelled figure and the hidden table carries one row per option.
